auth_sign_in_subtitle: Finyelela indzawo yakho yekusebenta esibhedlela ngendlela lephephile.
auth_welcome_back_body: Ngena ngemvume ngemvume kute ulawule tigulane, luhlu lwetintfo, ema-aphoyintimenti, kanye nekuhamba kwemisebenti yemtholampilo yelicembu lakho.
auth_welcome_signup_body: Dala i-akhawunti yekulawula tigulane, inventory, ema-aphoyintimenti, kanye nekuhamba kwemisebenti yemtholampilo yelicembu lakho.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Faka i-imeyili ku-akhawunti yakho. Sitawutfumela sixhumanisi sekusetha kabusha uma sihambisana nemsebentisi lobhalisiwe.
auth_check_email_body: Uma i-{email} ibhalisiwe, sixhumanisi sekusetha kabusha sisendleleni yaso. Lesikhonjiso siphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-15.
auth_otp_subtitle: Sitfumele ikhodi lenemadijithi langu-6 ku-{email}. Iphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-10.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Faka ikhodi lenemadijithi langu-6 kusuka ku-app yakho yekucinisekisa.
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Cinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho kute ukhicite ikhodi ye-QR yekucinisekisa.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Skena nge-app yakho yekucinisekisa, bese ufaka ikhodi lenemadijithi langu-6.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Gcina lamakhodi endzaweni lephephile. Ikhodi ngayinye ingasetjentiswa kanye.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Faka iphasiwedi yakho kute ucishe kucinisekisa lokunetigaba letimbili.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Faka esikhundleni sesicinisekiso sakho. Tinhlelo tekusebenta letikhona titawuyekela kusebenta uze uskene i-QR lensha.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Cinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho kute utsatse sikhundla sekhodi yakho ye-QR yekucinisekisa.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Faka iphasiwedi yakho. Emakhodi esipele langaphambilini atawuyekela kusebenta.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Emakhodi lamasha ekusekela alungile. Bagcine endzaweni lephephile.
session_extend_description: Cinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho kute wengete emahora langu-2 kuleseshini.
session_extend_password_hint: Faka iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti longene ngayo. Unganweba kanye ngeseshini.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Ngesikhatsi sekusetha ungaskena i-QR lefanako ngetintfo letingetulu kwalinye.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Kucinisekiswa kwetintfo letimbili kuyadzingeka kulesento. Lisethe kutsi lichubeke.
enter_email_reset_description: Faka i-imeyili yakho bese sikutfumelela sixhumanisi sekusetha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho.
invalid_reset_link: Sixhumanisi sekusetha kabusha lesingasebenti noma lesiphelelwe sikhatsi. Sicela ucele lensha ngephansi.
sign_up_failed: Kubhalisa kwehlulekile. Sicela uphindze uzame futsi.
reset_email_sent: Uma ngabe i-akhawunti ikhona yale-imeyili, kutfunyelwe sixhumanisi sekusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
password_reset_success: Iphasiwedi isethwe kabusha ngemphumelelo. Nyalo sewungangena ngemvume.
op_billing_select_visit_hint: Khetsa kuvakashela kute ucale kukhokhisa kwe-OP.
op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Lomtsetfosivivinyo washicilelwa; saphulelo selizinga lekuvakashela angeke sishintjwe.
op_billing_discount_locked_tooltip: Saphulelo sivaliwe ngemuva kwekutsi umtsetfosivivinyo ushicilelwe.
op_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Nursing lephelele ayikapheli; umtsetfosivivinyo angeke uvalwe.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Kute tinsita letiphelele letilindzelwe kukhokhiswa kwalokuvakasha.
op_billing_no_services_found: Kute tinsita leticedziwe letilindzelwe kukhokhiswa kwalokuvakasha.
op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Cedza umhlengikati lophelele kuyo yonkhe imigca yenkonzo ngaphambi kwekuvala.
ip_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Lomtsetfosivivinyo washicilelwa; saphulelo selizinga lekuvakashela angeke sishintjwe.
ip_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Nursing lephelele ayikapheli; umtsetfosivivinyo angeke uvalwe.
no_hospital_assigned: Kute sibhedlela lesabelwe ku-akhawunti yakho. Tsintsa umphatsi wakho.
no_hospitals_yet: Kute tibhedlela kwanyalo. Dala munye kute ucale.
owner_no_hospitals_yet: Kute tibhedlela kwanyalo. Tsintsa umphatsi wakho kute ucale.
hospital_coding_system_help: Ubopha lesibhedlela esigabeni sinye sekhodi yekuhlola ye-WHO. Angeke ishintje ngemuva kwekutsi kuhlolwa lokukhodiwe kukhona.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Luhlelo lwekukhoda luvaliwe ngoba lesibhedlela sesivele sinetihlolo letikhodiwe.
hospital_coding_release_unknown: Kute kungeniswa kwekhathalogu ye-WHO lokubhalwe phansi.
icd_who_attribution: ICD-10 kanye ICD-11 lokucuketfwe kulilungelo lokushicilela Inhlangano Yetemphilo Yemhlaba (WHO). ICD-11 inelayisensi ngaphansi kwe-CC NGU-ND 3.0 IGO. Kusebentisa kudzinga kutsi kube nekutsi; kuguculwa kwetintfo kudzinga imvume ye-WHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Sibhedlela ngasinye sibopha luhlelo lunye lwekukhoda lwekuhlola lwe-WHO (ICD-10 noma ICD-11 MMS) ngesikhatsi sekudala. EMR kuhlola search kusebentisa leyo khathalogu kuphela. Emakhathalogu lagcwele angeniswa nge-WHO ICD-API abe litafula lelikhulu lekwabelwana ngalo.
name: Ligama
admin_overview_subtitle: Tibalo kanye netindlela letimfisha tekuphatsa luhlelo.
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Kute tibhedlela kwanyalo. Dala munye bese ubopha umnikati.
admin_team_subtitle: Mema basiti bese usetha kutsi ngumaphi emakhasi e-admin labangawasebentisa.
admin_team_need_view: Okungenani likhasi linye kufanele libe nemvume yekubuka.
admin_team_invite_hint: Batawutfola i-imeyili yekusetha kabusha iphasiwedi kute basethe iphasiwedi yabo.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Kubuka kuyadzingeka ngaphambi kwekutsi udale, uhlele, nobe ususe ekhasini.
admin_team_reset_failed: Ayikhoni kutfumela i-imeyili yekusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Kusetjentiswa, umsebenti wakamuva, kanye nemphilo ye-database.
admin_staff_subtitle: Bonkhe basebentisi labanendzima yetisebenti etibhedlela tonkhe.
admin_ops_subtitle: Kusetjentiswa bukhoma, umsebenti wakamuva, kanye nemphilo ye-database.
admin_ops_load_error: Ayikhoni kulayisha umsebenti kanye nemininingwane yetemphilo.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Sessions kanye nekudala kwamuva kusuka ku-database bukhoma.
admin_ops_db_subtitle: Isimo sekuxhumana kanye nesitoreji kusuka ku-PostgreSQL.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: I-quota yeluhlelo ayivezwa nge-SQL. Bona i-Neon console kute utfole sitoreji lesikhona.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Usayizi wedathabeyisi uvela ku-PostgreSQL pg_database_sayizi (usayizi lonengcondvo kuleligatja le-Neon).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Neon luhlelo isitoreji quota akutholakali nge SQL. Kusetjentiswa vs kuyatfolakala kudzinga ikhonsoli yeNeon noma i-Neon API.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Tibalo temigca yetafula tibukhoma COUNT (*) kumathebula layinhloko, hhayi kulinganisa kwe-pg_stat.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Luphenyo lwekuxhumana lwehlulekile. Hlola i-DATABASE_URL kanye nesimo seligatja le-Neon.
no_owners_yet: Kute banikati kwanyalo. Dala lenye kute bakhone kufinyelela etibhedlela.
no_user_groups_yet: Kute emacembu ebasebentisi. Dala lenye yekwabela tisebenti.
no_user_groups_create: Kute emacembu ebasebentisi. Dala lenye ngenhla.
no_branches_yet: Kute emagala okwamanje. Ngeta ligatja lalesi sibhedlela.
user_groups_optional_hint: Khetsa licembu linye nobe ngetulu lebasebentisi (ungakhetsa).
store_central_help: Ngetulu kwaloko munye egatjeni ngalinye. I-GRN ifaka timphahla kulesitolo. Uma vele unesitolo lesisemkhatsini kuleligatja, cishe lapho ngaphambi kwekutsi usinike emandla lapha.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: Tiskena te-USB tivame kuthayipha ensimini legcile. Kuskena kwekhamera kungangetwa kamuva.
item_master_batch_required_help: Uma inikwe emandla, irisidi yemphahla kumele ifake ekhatsi inombolo ye-batch, lilanga lekuphelelwa sikhatsi, kanye nentsengo yekutsenga lentfo (lejwayelekile ekhemisi).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Khetsa iyunithi yentfo kucala, bese usebentisa Default kuhambisana nekuguculwa lokufaka ekhatsi.
Kute kuguculwa kweyunithi kusebentisa leyunithi yentfo ekutsengeni noma ekukhipheni.
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Khetsa lokujwayelekile emkhatsini wekuguculwa kweyunithi lokufakiwe.
item_master_category_hint: Kuphela Kwekuphakela Lokuvamile, Kuphakela Kwemakhemisi, noma Kuphakela Kwekwelapha (kusuka ku-Category Master).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Khetsa i-generic yekhemisi yetintfo tekuniketa ikhemisi.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Kute emakhemisi lafanako. Dala lenye ngenhla.
unit_master_empty: Kute emayunithi okwamanje. Dala lenye ngenhla.
no_item_unit_profiles: Kute lokugucukile kwanyalo. Dala lenye ngenhla.
confirm_delete_refer: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kucisha le refer?
support_unauthorized: Kufanele ungene ngemvume kute usebentise kusekelwa.
nursing_case_sheet_save_success: Liphepha lecala ligcinwe kuloko lokunamatsiselwe esigulini.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Kwehlulekile kugcina liphepha lelicala kuloko lokunamatsiselwe esigulini.
clinical_document_save_failed: Kwehlulekile kugcina lifomu kuloko lokunamatsiselwe esigulini.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Khetsa kuvakashela usebentisa inkinobho letsi 'Khetsa Kuvakashela' lengetulu kute ubuke liphepha lelicala.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Khetsa kuvakashela usebentisa inkinobho letsi 'Khetsa Kuvakashela' lengetulu kute ubuke idatha yekubuka.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Lokuvakasha kwagcinwa njengobe kusayinwe. Kubuka kanye nekuhlela kwe-CPOE kukhubatekile uze ukhetse lokunye kuvakasha.
clinical_visit_unsign_confirm: Ucinisekile yini kutsi uhlehlisa kugcina njengobe kusayiniwe?
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Gcina lokuvakasha njengalokusayiniwe? Loku angeke kuhlehliswe. Kubuka kanye nekuhlela i-CPOE kutawukhubateka kulokuvakasha; ibhentji lekusebenta lebuhlengikati lihlala litfolakala.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Luhlelo Lwekunakekela alutfolakali kulokwakha. Sebentisa luhlelo lwekunakekela lwe-EMR lwebuhlengikati uma selulungile.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_not_found: Lelo rekhodi leluhlelo lwekunakekelwa alizange litfolakale.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_delete_hint: Loku lokubhalwe phansi kutawubekwa kutsi akusebenti.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Emanothi enchubekelembili awatfolakali kulokwakha. Sebentisa emanothi enchubekelembili ye-EMR yebuhlengikati uma seyilungile.
observation_emr_progress_note_delete_hin: Loku lokubhalwe phansi kutawubekwa kutsi akusebenti.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Bhala ticondziso temtsetfo, imitsi, umthamo, kanye neseluleko sesigulane...
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Lomugca usemtsetfweni we-OP lovaliwe futsi angeke uhlelelwe noma ungasebenti.
observation_emr_inactivate_hint: Loku lokubhalwe phansi kutawubekwa kutsi akusebenti.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Lomugca we-oda utawubhalwa kutsi awusebenti futsi ungafakwa ekukhokheni kwe-OP.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Thayipha kabusha inchazelo yekungena ngetansi kute ungasebenti loku lokungenako.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Loku kutawususa i-akhawunti yabo futsi ngeke basakhona kungena ngemvume.
service_item_select_category_sub_categor: Sicela ukhetse sigaba kanye nesigaba lesincane.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Tincetu tihlanganiswa kute kwakhiwe ikhodi ngayinye. Ngeta umbhalo locinile, emasimu emininingwane, kanye nenombolo lesebentako.
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Faka lokungenani sicucu sinye kufomethi yekhodi.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Ifomethi legciniwe ayikwazanga kulayishwa; kucala kusuka ekuhleleni lokujwayelekile.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Setha kutsi emakhodi esiguli, tinombolo tekuvakashela, kanye netinombolo te-oda lensita takhiwa njani. Injongo ngayinye isebentisa ukhiye weluhlelo lolungagucuki; ushintja kuphela inchazelo kanye nefomethi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Isetjentiswa uma kubhaliswa tigulane letinsha. Luhlobo lwekuvakashela alutfolakali kulekhodi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Isetjentiselwa kuvakashelwa kwesiguli ngasinye; kufaka ekhatsi luhlobo lweligatja kanye nekuvakashela nangabe leto tinsimu tisefomethini.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Isetjentiswa lapho kudala ema-oda enkonzo. Ifomethi lejwayelekile ihambisana ne-YY/kuvakashela/NNN. Vula “Kulandzelana lokuhlukile ngekuvakashela” ngako-ke tinombolo te-oda tibala 001, 002... ngekuvakashela sigulane (kunconywa). Uma kucishiwe, kulandzelana kwabelwana ngawo onkhe ema-oda lasebentisa letinye tilungiselelo letifanako tebubanti.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Isetjentiswa lapho kudala ticelo tekutsenga (PR). Lungisa loku ngaphambi kwekutsi tisebenti tidale ema-PR.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Isetjentiswa lapho kudala ema-oda ekutsenga (PO). Lungisa loku ngaphambi kwekutsi tisebenti tidale ema-PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Isetjentiswa lapho udala indents umnyango. Lungiselela loku ngaphambi kwekutsi tisebenti tidale ema-indents.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Isetjentiswa lapho kudala tindzaba telitiko kusuka emkhatsini kuya etitolo tekucela.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Isetjentiswa uma kuhanjiswa imibhalo yekusetjentiswa kwelitiko kutsi ivunywe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Isetjentiswa uma ugcina ema-oda emitsi yangaphakathi. Yonkhe imigca ku-save yinye yabelana ngalenombolo ye-batch. Default usebentisa umnyaka wetimali, sibhedlela, kanye nekulandzelana lokugijimako.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Khetsa kutsi ngutiphi tilinganiso letihlukanisa inombolo egijimako. Ifomethi yekubonisa lengenhla ihlukile; loku kuthinta kuphela kutsi utfola kulandzelana lokungakanani lokutimele.
inv_grn_api_hint: Dala ema-GRN nge-POST nge-poId, storeId (emkhatsini), Lusuku lolutfoliwe, kanye nemigca. Umugca ngamunye: poLineId, Qty letsengiwe (ngaphandle kwamahhala), batchNo, Lusuku lwekuphelelwa sikhatsi, Intsengo yekutsenga (iyadzingeka uma intfo inekulandzelela kwe-batch). Emaqoqo ajwayelekile (intfo_iqoqo); sitoko sitolo ngasinye kanye nesicumbi (inv_sitoko).
inv_approval_config_intro: Lungiselela emazinga ekuvunywa kanye nebanikati besitolo kanye neluhlobo lwedokhumenti lolukhetsile ngenhla.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Imiphumela yeluphenyo ifaka ekhatsi ku-hand esitolo lesikhetsiwe (kusuka) kuphela (yunithi yekukhipha uma itfolakala).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: View uvula lelirisidi ekhasini layo; Emuva kubuyela lapha (hhayi kundzaba yeLitiko).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Imigca `inv_stock` ihlanganiswe ne `intfo_batch`, leyalwe ngekuphelelwa sikhatsi (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Hlunga emacembu ebasebentisi ngeligama noma id...
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Faka inani lelivunyiwe ngemugca uma kufanele lehluke kulokuceliwe. I-PR qty lelindzelwe ihlanganisa imigca lehambisanako levela kulesitolo lesicelako (ilindzelwe, itfunyelwe emuva, noma ivunyiwe), kufaka ekhatsi lesicelo.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Kute tintfo letikhona. Chafata + kute wengete intfo, bese Gcina i-oda.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Khetsa sicelo sekutsenga lesivumelekile ngenhla. Litafula litawulayisha lapha ngemugca ngamunye: intfo, iyunithi (Intfo Iyunithi Master kuguculwa), linani lelisele, linani le-oda, kanye nentsengo yeyunithi.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Khetsa intfo kucala, bese ukhetsa iyunithi (kugucula) eluhlwini lwe-Item Unit Master yalentfo.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Lentfo ayinato tingucuko teyunithi letisebentako. Lungisa ngaphansi kwekusetha kwe-Inventory → Inkhosi yentfo.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Khetsa sitolo sekutsenga lesisemkhatsini ebhaleni lelisetulu. Ticelo letivunyiwe te-oda lelisha lekutsenga tibhalwa kuphela nangabe leso sitolo sikhetsiwe: titfunyelwa ekutsengeni lokusemkhatsini, hhayi kuletinye titolo letifana nekhemisi lelingasiyo i-CPS lelungisiwe.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Lungisa sitolo sekutsenga lesisemkhatsini ngaphansi kwekusetha kwe-Inventory → Config ye-inventory yesibhedlela ngaphambi kwekutsi udale ema-oda ekutsenga kusuka eticelo.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Vala lomugca we PO bese umaka qty lesele njengalevaliwe?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Vala lomugca we-PR qty lesele (setha kuvulwa-kwe-PO ku 0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Kute sitolo lesisemkhatsini lesilungiselelwe leligatja le-oda lekutsenga. Irisidi yemphahla kumele ifakwe esitolo lesisemkhatsini seligatja. Kusetha kwe-Inventory, maka sitolo sinye ngco ngeligatja ngalinye njengalesisemkhatsini (sitolo lesisemkhatsini), bese uyazama futsi.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Khetsa i-oda lekutsenga kute ubone sitolo lesitfolako.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Inombolo ye-batch, kuphelelwa sikhatsi, kanye nentsengo yekutsenga kuyadzingeka etintfweni letilandzelwa nge-batch.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Khetsa lokunyenti esitolo semtfombo, noma ulayishe lokunyenti ngemuva kwekukhetsa titolo.
inv_hub_card_po: Dala futsi uvume ema-oda ekutsenga, utfumele kumphakeli.
inv_hub_card_grn: Rekhoda irisidi yemphahla ngekumelene nema-oda ekutsenga.
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Kutsenga lokusemkhatsini kwabelwe ngaphansi kwe-config yeluhlu lwetintfo teSibhedlela.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: PR, PO, kanye GRN for timphahla letitsengiwe basebentisa lesi sitolo. Sitolo lesikhetsiwe sibhalwe ngekutsi kutsengwa kweNkhaba; leyo yangaphambilini ibuyela ku-Regular.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Uma umugca ugcwele ku-oda (s) lekutsenga, linani lelivulekile lingu-0 lapha; umkhondo loyalwe, lotfoliwe, futsi losatawutfolakala etikrinini te-PO ne-GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Ema-oda ekutsenga akhona kule-PR kepha luhlu aluzange lulayishwe. Yetama kuvuselela lelikhasi.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Ibha lesetulu isetha inventory yakho / sicelo (kusuka) esitolo. Loluhlu lukhombisa ticelo letiphakanyiswe nguleso sitolo. Khetsa Tonkhe titolo kute ubone ticelo letivela kuto tonkhe titolo leticelako, nobe usebentise luhlu lwekholomu yesitolo kute unciphise ngekutsi Kusuka esitolo.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Sitoko silinganiselwe esitolo ebha lephezulu. Khetsa Tonkhe titolo kute ubone tonkhe titolo esibhedlela.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Loluhlu lulinganiselwe kuma-indents laphakanyiswe sitolo ebhaleni lelisetulu. Khetsa Tonkhe titolo kute ubone tonkhe tincenye telitiko.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Dala sicelo sekutsenga esitolo lesicelako (ibha lesetulu) → ngemuva kwekuvunywa, dala i-oda lekutsenga bese uposa i-GRN esitolo lesitfolako → eluhlwini lwe-GRN, sebentisa Kudlulisela kuhambisa sitoko lesitfoliwe esitolo lesivule sicelo (uma i-PR ixhumene ne-PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Kusuka esitolo kuvela ebha phezulu. Khetsa i Kugcina lesicelo.
inv_flow_po_context: Ema-PO esitolo lesikhetsiwe (ibha lesetulu) alandzela ticelo tekutsenga letivunyiwe noma kungena ngesandla; kuvuma bese utfumela kumphakeli ngaphambi kwekutsi kutfolakale timphahla.
inv_flow_grn_context: Posa emarisidi esitolo sekwamukela (ibha lesetulu). Uma i-PO ixhunywe nesicelo, sebentisa i-Transfer kutfumela sitoko esitolo lesicelako ngemuva kwekuposa i-GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Khetsa sitolo ebhaleni lelisetulu kute ugcilele kuloluhlu, nobe usebentise Onkhe ema-oda ekutsenga esibhedlela nangabe kute sitolo lesikhetsiwe.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Sitolo lesisemkhatsini (ibha lesetulu = Kusuka esitolo) siphakamisa tindzaba etitolo leticelako: kungaba kusuka ku-indent yelitiko levunyiwe lelindze kugcwaliseka, noma ngesandla ngaphandle kwe-indent.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Njengema-oda ekutsenga: sebentisa Indent Lensha levela etikolweni uma sitoko sicelwa esitolo sakho lesisemkhatsini ngekusebentisa indent; sebentisa iManual uma kungekho indent.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Shintja kulawula “Kusuka esitolo” ebha lesetulu (eceleni kweligatja / licembu lemsebentisi) uma sigaba se-Inventory sivulekile.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Leti indents tivunyelwe sitolo lesicelako futsi tilindze wena kutsi uvule ludzaba lwelitiko. Khetsa sitolo lesisemkhatsini ebha lesetulu.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Dala ludzaba lwelitiko kusuka ku-Inventory → Ludzaba lwelitiko → Lokusha kusuka ku-indent yelitiko (sitolo lesisemkhatsini kumele sihambisane nalesitolo se-indent “kuya” ebhaleni lelisetulu).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Khetsa sitolo lesisemkhatsini (lesigcwalisako) ebhaleni lelisetulu. Luhlu lukhombisa tindzaba lapho leso sitolo ngumkhiciti (Kusuka).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Vuma kutsi utfole esitolo sakho lesicelako (kusuka ebha). Ema-indents lakhishiwe avela lapha kuze kube ngulapho atfolakala.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Khetsa sitolo sakho lesicelako ebhaleni lelisetulu kute ubhale ema-indent lalindzile kutfolakala kuleso sitolo.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Rekhoda kusetjentiswa esitolo ngekubanjwa kwelizinga le-batch. Hambisa kutsi kuvunywe; kuvunywa kwekugcina kuposa kusetjentiswa futsi kunciphisa sitoko.
inv_dc_list_scope_hint: Luhlu lungalandzela sitolo ebha lesetulu noma lukhombise tonkhe titolo.
inv_dc_configure_dc_approvers: Lungiselela bavumi bekusetjentiswa kwelitiko (imojuli DC) yalesitolo ku-Inventory Setup → Kucushwa kwekuvunywa.
inv_dc_modal_batch_help: Emabhetshi alayishwa kusuka esitokisini esitolo lesikhetsiwe salentfo.
inv_dc_batch_qty_exceeds_stock: Inani lendlula sitoko lesikhona se-batch yinye noma ngetulu.
medication_order_external_sales_empty: Incola kute lutfo. Ngeta tintfo ngasencele.
med_order_save_failed: Angizange ngikhone kugcina. Hlola lokufakako bese uyazama futsi.
med_order_batch_pick_help: Faka linani ngesicumbi (yunithi yekutsenga). Tibalo letiphelele tivumelanisa nensimu yelinani lelayini.
med_order_inventory_invalid: Hlola emanani e-batch kanye nentsengo yekutsengisa.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_r: Inombolo yerisidi yekuphuma ngekuhamba ngekutsengisa kwangaphandle.
med_order_int_missing_master: Lungisa imvamisa, iyunithi yemthamo, kanye neyunithi yesikhatsi kusetha kwe-oda leMitsi, bese uyazama futsi.
med_order_int_past_start: Lusuku lwekucala angeke lube ngaphambi kwalamuhla.
med_order_int_save_failed: Kugcina kwehlulekile. Hlola umlayeto weseva bese uyazama futsi.
med_order_int_update_failed: Kubuyeketa kwehlulekile. Hlola umlayeto weseva bese uyazama futsi.
med_order_int_saved: I-oda lemitsi ligcinwe. Kwabelwa inombolo lensha ye-batch.
med_order_int_delete_confirm: Cisha yonkhe i-batch nayo yonkhe imigca yayo? Loku angeke kuhlehliswe.
med_order_int_editing: Kuhlela i-oda legciniwe: tingucuko tisebenta ku-Update.
med_order_int_reorder_stagger_aria: Dala i-oda lensha legciniwe (i-batch lensha) kusuka kumugca wekucala wale-oda. Sikhatsi sekucala ngemuva kwesikhatsi sekugcina sakamuva kulokuvakasha, noma kusukela nyalo uma ngabe loko bekutawuba sesikhatsini lesengcile.
med_order_int_reorder_append_confirm: Gcina i-oda lelisha ngenombolo lensha ye-batch, usebentisa umugca wekucala wale-oda? Sikhatsi sekucala sisethwa ngemuva kwekuphela kwemugca wakho wangaphambilini. Uhlala eluhlwini lwemlandvo.
med_order_int_reorder_line_appended: I-oda lelisha lagcinwa ngenombolo lensha ye-batch.
med_order_int_starts_staggered_toast: Tikhatsi tekucala tilandzela kulandzelana kwemigca. Umugca ngamunye ucala ngemuva kwesikhatsi lesiphelele semugca wangaphambilini. Imvamisa kanye nemithamo akushintjwa.
inv_pr_create_disabled_store_not_requisi: Lesitolo asikhoni kudala ticelo tekutsenga. Vula kutsenga lokudzingekako ku-Store Master.
home_inv_dashboard_subtitle: Umbiko jikelele webubanti beligatja lelikhetsiwe ebha yekuhamba.
home_inv_dashboard_stock_alerts_hint: Tibalo tifaka ekhatsi titolo kuphela emagatjeni akho lakhetsiwe. Tecwayiso letise-app kanye nema-imeyili atfunyelwa ngesitolo ngasinye lobhalise kuso, futsi ngekwehlukana ngesitoko lesiphansi vs siphelelwa sikhatsi masinyane (faka sitolo ngasinye ngaphansi kwekusetha kwe-Inventory → Tecwayiso tesitoko).
inv_reports_card_dc_desc: Imigca yekusebentisa leposiwe ngentsengo yekutsengisa ye-EMP kanye nemanani emgca.
inv_report_date_range_invalid: Lusuku kuya kumele lube mhla noma ngemuva kwelusuku kusuka.
inv_reorder_level_subtitle: Setha imikhawulo yesitoko lesiphansi ngesitolo ngasinye kanye nentfo.
inv_reorder_level_min_qty_conversion_hin: Faka linani lelincane kumayunithi ekutsenga; igcinwa njengesitoko (inkinga) inani kusetjentiswa kuguculwa lokukhetsiwe.
inv_stock_alert_subtitle: Khetsa kutsi ngusiphi sitolo umuntfu ngamunye lesigadzako, kanye nekugucuka kwe-imeyili kanye nelifasitelo leliphelelwa sikhatsi-masinyane.
inv_stock_alert_policy_hint: Emafasitelo ekuphelelwa sikhatsi ngentfo ngayinye angasethwa ku-Item Master (icitsa lokujwayelekile kwesibhedlela ngezansi).
inv_stock_alert_policy_email_channels: Tecwayiso letiku-app tilandzela emabhokisi ekuhlola eBemukeli kuphela. Kuze utfole ema-imeyili futsi, vula luhlobo ngalunye lwesecwayiso lapha (lolugcinwe), hlela i-SMTP kuseva, futsi ucinisekise kutsi kungena ngemvume kwe-Better Auth kwelilunga ngalinye letisebenti linelikheli le-imeyili.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_days: Emalanga laphelelwa sikhatsi-masinyane kumele abe emkhatsini wa-1 na-365.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_gap: Imizuzu yekupholisa kumele ibe ngu-1 lokungenani.
inv_stock_alert_recipients_hint: Umugca ngamunye sitolo sinye kanye nelilunga linye letisebenti. Tecwayiso tifaka ekhatsi sitoko saleso sitolo kuphela: hambisana nekholomu yeSitolo embikweni wesitoko lesiphansi. Sebentisa emabhokisi ekuhlola latsi Low stock / Siphelelwa sikhatsi masinyane ngemugca ngamunye; Inchubomgomo iphindze ibe nekushintja kwe-imeyili lehlukile. Kungafakwa tisebenti letibekwe esibhedlela kuphela.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: Lelo lunga letisebenti selivele libhalwe kulesi sitolo.
inv_stock_alert_select_store_staff: Khetsa kokubili sitolo kanye nelilunga letisebenti.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: Kute utfole tecwayiso letifika ngesikhatsi kanye ne-imeyili, shayela lendzawo yekugcina ngeluhlelo (sib. njalo ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-15). Sebentisa i-imeyili = 1 kuphela uma i-SMTP ilungiselelwe.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Tfumela Sigunya senhloko: Umtfwali <CRON_IMFIHLO> noma x-cron-imfihlo. Setha i-CRON_SECRET endzaweni yeseva.
inv_store_markup_percent_invalid: Kumamakwa kwesitolo kumele kube emkhatsini wa-0 na-999.
inv_pricing_template_subtitle: Emafomula entsengo yekutsengisa laphindze asetjentiswe (MSL, emafulegi etindleko). Yabela ligatja kanye nemojuli ngekucushwa kwemanani.
inv_pricing_assignment_subtitle: Khetsa ithempulethi yinye yefomula ngeligatja ngalinye kanye nemojuli yekutsengisa. Kutsengisa kanye nekugeleta kwekukhipha kusebentisa ithempulethi leyabelwe ngesikhatsi sekuthengiselana.
inv_pricing_assignment_unassigned_warnin: Kute ithempulethi leyabelwe: kutsengisa kwale mojuli kuleligatja kutawehluleka uze unikete sinye.
inv_pricing_assignment_overview_subtitle: Nguyiphi ithempulethi yefomula lesebenta esibhedlela ngasinye, ligatja, kanye nemojuli.
inv_pricing_config_subtitle: Yabela ithempulethi yefomula ligatja ngalinye kanye nemojuli yekutsengisa (kutsengisa kwangekhatsi, kutsengisa kwangaphandle, kusetjentiswa kwelitiko).
inv_pricing_config_branch_locked_hint: Kusebentisa ligatja kusuka ebha yekuhamba: {branch}. Khetsa “Onkhe Emagatja” ku- nav kute ukhetse ligatja lelehlukile lapha.
inv_pricing_config_sale_help_manual: Faka intsengo yekutsengisa emgceni ngamunye we-GRN uma uposa.
inv_pricing_config_emp_use_percent_of_sa: Sebentisa emaphesenti entsengo yekutsengisa (ungakunaki kugucuka kwetindleko ngephansi)
inv_pricing_config_emp_help_manual: Faka intsengo yekutsengisa yetisebenti emgceni ngamunye we-GRN uma uposa.
inv_pricing_config_invalid_markup: Kumaka kumele kube emkhatsini wa 0 na 999.
inv_pricing_config_invalid_emp_percent: Emaphesenti etisebenti kumele abe emkhatsini wa-0 na-999.
inv_pricing_preview_hint: Kubalwa kusuka kufomula leyabelwe ngesikhatsi sekutsengiselana (hhayi kugcinwa ku-batch).
inv_pricing_preview_unavailable: Ayikhoni kubalwa kubukeka kwentsengo. Hlola umsebenti wemojuli kanye nesixhumanisi se-GRN se-batch.
item_master_item_markup_percent_hint: Kuyakhetfwa. Kusetjentiswa esikhaleni se-ITEM uma kubalwa intsengo yekutsengisa ngesikhatsi sekukhipha noma sekukhokha.
item_master_item_markup_percent_invalid: Kumamakwa kwentfo kumele kube emkhatsini wa-0 na-999.
inv_store_markup_percent_hint: Kuyakhetfwa. Kusetjentiswa ku-STORE slot lapho kubalwa intsengo yekutsengisa kusuka kulesitolo.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_hint: Kukhetsa ngekutsandza. Emalanga ngaphambi kwekuphelelwa sikhatsi kufaka umjeka wetinkatho njengaletiphelelwa sikhatsi masinyane. Shiya kungenalutfo kute usebentise lokujwayelekile kwesibhedlela kusuka ku-Stock alerts.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_inval: Faka inombolo lephelele emkhatsini wa-1 na-365, nobe ushiye lutfo.

home_seo_title: EmaMedora | Kusebenta esibhedlela lokuthulile kwawo onkhe emacembu ekunakekela
home_seo_description: Medora yi-EMR yetibhedlela letinyenti yekubhalisa, kuvakashela, umsebenti wemtholampilo, inventory, kanye nekuphatsa. Ikhonsoli yinye yeSoft Wash yebanikati, tisebenti, kanye netitezi tekunakekela.
home_hero_headline: Gucula emalanga esibhedlela abe ngumgeleta lothulile, lohlangene
home_hero_body: Medora: imisebenti yekunakekelwa kwetibhedlela letinyenti ngekubhalisa, kuvakashelwa, emabhentshi ekusebenta emtholampilo, kanye neluhlu lwetintfo letikhona kukhonsoli yinye yebaqashi.
home_how_lead: Kugeleta lokukodwa kwekuhamba-ins kanye nekunakekelwa lokubhukiwe. Yakhiwe for tikhatsi emacembu empeleni kuhambisa tigulane.
home_how_step1_body: Bamba bunikati, kugula, kanye nemlandvo kanye. Njalo nawuvakashela kamuva uphindze asebentise lishadi lelifanako.
home_how_step2_body: Dala kuvakashelwa kwe-OP noma kwe-IP, unamatsele ema-aphoyintimenti, futsi ugcine umongo weligatja ucacile phansi.
home_how_step3_body: Tintfo letibalulekile tebuhlengikati, kuhlola, ema-oda emitsi, kanye nemibhalo ihlala ngesikhatsi lesifanako sekuvakasha.
home_how_step4_body: Tindzaba te-inventory, kuniketwa kwetikweleti, kanye netinyatselo tekukhishwa tihlala tihlangene nelirekhodi lekuvakasha.
home_modules_lead: Emaphakethe emakhono ambonya emadeski lokufanele ahlale avumelana: lihhovisi lelingaphambili, titezi temtholampilo, titolo, kanye ne-admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Inkhosi yesigulane, kudalwa kwekuvakasha, kucashwa, kanye nekungena ngekwati ligatja.
home_modules_clinical_body: Emamojuli ebuhlengikati kanye nekubonisana ngetintfo letibalulekile, kuhlola, ema-oda, kanye nemanothi e-EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Titolo, emacembu, i-PR/PO/GRN, kusetjentiswa kwelitiko, kanye netecwayiso tesitoko.
home_modules_admin_body: Basebenti, emagatja, emacembu ebasebentisi, emakhosi, emadokhumenti, kanye nekuhleleka kwesibhedlela.
home_model_heading: I-SaaS yinye. Tibhedlela letinyenti. Tindzima leticacile.
home_model_lead: Medora isibhedlela lesiningi ngekuklanywa. Ipulatifomu idala lesibhedlela. Lesibhedlela siphetse kunakekelwa. Tigulane atize tidzinge lihhovisi lakho lelingemuva.
home_model_platform_body: Baphatsi beluhlelo banikati bembewu, tibhedlela, kanye netindzawo tekuvikela wonkhe umqashi lahlanganyela ngato.
home_model_hospital_body: Banikati nebaphatsi bahlela emagatja, titolo, kufinyelela kwetisebenti, kanye nemakhosi.
home_model_staff_body: Bahlengikati, bodokotela, kanye nemacembu esitolo basebenta kusuka kumamojula lacondza indzima phansi.
home_model_patients_body: Emashadi, kuvakashelwa, kanye nemibhalo kuhlala esibhedlela; tisebenti tikhonta kusuka ku-console.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Tintfo letibalulekile, ema-allergies, emanothi ebuhlengikati, kanye nemisebenti leseceleni kwembhedze ngaphandle kwekushiya kuvakasha.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Kuhlola, ema-oda emitsi, kanye nemibhalo yemtholampilo yelideski ladokotela.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Tfola, ukhiphe, udlulisele, futsi ucwaninge sitoko ngekucaphela ngesicumbi kanye nekuphelelwa sikhatsi.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Basebenti, emagatja, emacembu ekufinyelela, emakhosi emadokhumenti, kanye nekuhleleka.
home_integrated_heading: Gcina onkhe emadeski emgceni wesikhathi munye
home_integrated_lead: Kubekwa, imitsi, imibhalo, kanye nekuhamba kwesitoko kwabelana ngekuvakasha ngako phansi kuhlala kuhambisana.
home_integrated_f5: Tecwayiso tesitoko kanye nemibiko yekuphelelwa sikhatsi
home_cta_body: Ngena ngemvume ku-Medora console, ukhetse sibhedlela, bese ucala kusuka kumamojula licembu lakho lelivele liwasebentisa.
home_footer_tagline: Imisebenti yesibhedlela yekubhalisa, kunakekelwa emtholampilo, luhlu lwetintfo, kanye nekuphatsa.
home_footer_copyright: © {year} Umuntfu lohamba embili. Isofthiwe yekunakekela nguMenzies.
home_scene_aria: Umfanekiso we Soft Wash wesibhedlela eceleni kwetihlahla egcekeni lelithulile
pricing_seo_description: Intsengo ye-EMR yesibhedlela saseMedora: Ifu kusuka ku- $ 99 / mo (Umcali kuya Epulatifomu). On-premise usebentisa tiers letifanako ngentsengo ye-Cloud + $ 150 / mo yekufaka kusakhiwonchanti sakho. Kubhalisa, emtholampilo, inventory, kanye ne-admin.
pricing_lead: I-Cloud SaaS noma i-On-premise kusakhiwonchanti sakho. Sicalo lesifanako, Ibhizinisi, Sikali, kanye netigaba tePlatifomu. Size yetibhedlela kanye nemamojula, hhayi kukhatsateka ngemitha yekuvakashela.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud isingatwa Soft Wash Medora: SaaS yetibhedlela letinyenti, tibuyeketo letilawulwako, kanye nesakhiwonchanti lesabelwana ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi losiphetse.
pricing_lead_onprem: On-premise ngumkhicito lofanako tiers, kufakwe futsi kusethwe kumaseva akho, database, kanye nenethiwekhi. Nguwe umnikati wesakhiwonchanti. Luhla lwanyanga yonkhe ngu-Cloud + $ {premium} ngalowo mtfwalo.
pricing_lead_mmk: Kukhombisa i-MMK ku-1 USD = {rate} MMK yekucatsanisa kwendzawo.
pricing_lead_usd: USD luhla emanani emacembu emhlabeni wonkhe.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline: Sibhedlela sinye ku sibambe Soft Wash Medora.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline_onprem: Sibhedlela sinye Soft Wash Medora kusakhiwonchanti sakho.
pricing_plan_starter_f6: Kusekelwa nge-imeyili kanye nekubuyeketwa lokuchubekako kwe-Cloud
pricing_plan_starter_f6_onprem: Kusekelwa nge-imeyili; tibuyeketo endleleni yakho yekukhululwa
pricing_plan_business_tagline: Imfumba legcwele yesibhedlela yemacembu ekunakekela lakhulako.
pricing_plan_business_tagline_onprem: Stack sesibhedlela lesiphelele sifakwe ku infra yakho.
pricing_plan_business_f1: Kuze kube tibhedlela letingu-3 ku-SaaS lebanjwe
pricing_plan_business_f1_onprem: Kuze kube ngu-3 tibhedlela kusakhiwonchanti sakho
pricing_plan_business_f2: Emagatja, emacembu ebasebentisi, kanye nemakhosi emadokhumenti
pricing_plan_business_f4: PR / PO / GRN kanye netecwayiso tesitoko
pricing_plan_scale_tagline_onprem: Multi-ops esibhedlela ku infra yakho ngekuhlanganiswa.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline_onprem: Operators labaphetse tibhedlela letinyenti ku infra yakho.
pricing_plan_platform_f2: Sivakashi lesinelebuli lemhlophe kanye netindzawo letiphrintiwe
pricing_plan_platform_f6: Imilayeto yevolumu kanye netinketho tekuhlala kwedatha
pricing_plan_platform_f6_onprem: Imilayeto yevolumu kanye nekuhlala lokucinile kunethiwekhi yakho
pricing_who_lead: Ipulatifomu, sibhedlela, tisebenti, netigulane ngamunye utfola umzila locacile. Khetsa Cloud noma On-premise, bese tier lefanako lehambisana kutsi tingakhi tibhedlela kanye nemamojula lowugijima.
pricing_who_platform_body: Basebentisi labahlanyela tibhedlela letinyenti futsi labadzinga i-white-label kanye ne-SSO. Khetsa Ipulatifomu ku-Cloud nobe Endzaweni.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Banikati kanye nebaphatsi labacubungula emagala, titolo, kufinyelela kwetisebenti, kanye nemakhosi. Ibhizinisi noma Sikali sihambisana nemacembu lamanyenti emasayithi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Bahlengikati, bodokotela, kanye nemacembu esitolo kumamojula lacondza indzima. Imikhawulo yesihlalo sikali ngeluhlelo; tigulane atikaze tibone lihhovisi lelingemuva.
pricing_who_patients_body: Emashadi, kuvakashelwa, kanye nemibhalo kuhlala esibhedlela. Basebenti bakhonta kusuka kukhonsoli ngaphesheya kwekubhalisa ngekuvala.
pricing_faq_a1: Tiers letishicilelwe ngelicembu ngalinye lesibhedlela ngetimphahla tesibhedlela nesitulo. I-Cloud kanye ne-On-premise yabelana ngeSicali, Ibhizinisi, Sikali, kanye nePlatifomu. Luhla lwanyanga yonkhe lolusendzaweni luyi-Cloud + $ 150. Kute imodi lesebentisa imitha yekuvakasha ngayinye lekhuphuka ngemalanga lamatasatasa.
pricing_faq_a2: Kukhiya kwekukhokha kwaminyaka yonkhe ngemnyaka locagelako weSoft Wash Medora. I-SaaS yesibhedlela sesitayela se-Loomline ivame kwehlisa tinhlelo temnyaka nga-15 kuya ku-20%. I-Medora ifaka sicelo se-20% eluhlwini lwanyanga yonkhe uma ukhokha njalo ngemnyaka, kukho kokubili i-Cloud kanye ne-On-premise (ngemuva kwe-premium ye-+$150 E-on-premise).
pricing_faq_q3: Ngabe kufakwe emamojula e-inventory kanye nemtholampilo?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter kufaka ekhatsi kubhalisa core, kuvakashela, kanye nemabhentshi ekusebenta emtholampilo nge inventory lesisekelo. Emabhizinisi nalangetulu kuvula imisebenti lephelele yeluhlu lwetintfo, ema-oda emitsi lahlobene nesitokwe, kanye nekuhleleka kwemphatsi lokucebile. Buta kutsi udzinga nini tintfo letingetiwe letilawulwako.
pricing_faq_a4: Sebentisa i-toggle yemakethe ngetulu kwetinhlelo. Global ukhombisa USD kuphela. I-Myanmar ikhombisa i-MMK ku-1 USD = 5000 MMK (nge-USD njengemugca wesibili). Sikhatsi sekukhokha kanye nemodi yenkonzo kwehlukile emakethe.
pricing_faq_a5: Ifu lisingatwa Soft Wash Medora: SaaS yetibhedlela letinyenti, tibuyeketo letilawulwako, kanye nekucala lokusheshako. On-premise usebentisa ema tiers lafanako, afakwe kusakhiwonchanti sakho uma udzinga kulawula noma kuhlala. Infra ngeyakho; luhlu lwanyanga yonkhe ngu-Cloud + $ 150 ngalowo mtfwalo.
pricing_trial_lead: Sitjele ngetibhedlela takho nekutsi udzinga sikhatsi lesingakanani. Sitawulandzela nge-imeyili.
pricing_trial_message_placeholder: Emasayithi, umtfwalo lomkhulu, i-Cloud noma lokukhetsako lokusendzaweni...
pricing_trial_success: Sicelo sekuvivinywa sitfoliwe. Sitawulandzela nge-imeyili masinyane.
pricing_trial_error_duration: Khetsa sikhatsi sekulinga: emalanga langu-7, emaviki langu-2, nobe inyanga yinye.
pricing_trial_error_send: Angizange ngikhone kutfumela sicelo sakho. Yetama futsi ngemuva kwesikhatsi.
hospital_logo_invalid_type: Ucelwa kutsi ukhetse sitfombe se-JPEG, se-PNG, se-WebP nobe se-GIF.
hospital_logo_too_large: Sitfombe kumele sibe ngu-5MB nobe ngaphansi.
